items.title: The left adjoint of the Gabriel-Popescu functor preserves injective maps
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file injectives.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the adjoint of an injective map into a value of the Gabriel-Popescu functor is again injective (statement lines 2830-2834). The proof is a complete argument: the author first tests composites on the generator to obtain the equality of the two kernels in the finite case (proof lines 2838-2862); then, choosing a presentation of the module by copies of the ring, injectivity is reduced to the equality of two subobjects of a direct sum of copies of the generator, which is verified by expressing that direct sum as the filtered colimit of its finite subsums and using exactness of filtered colimits together with the finite case (proof lines 2863-2874). The non-formal content is the reduction to the presentation and the filtered colimit argument. The claim is H2.
